# HTTP API reference

Enterprise Knowledge & Support Copilot API - version 0.1.0. Every operation except login and the health probes requires `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>`; errors use `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id"}}`. `/metrics` is served only with a bearer token configured and is not part of this schema. Interactive docs are disabled in staging/production.

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/audit` | List Events |
| GET | `/api/v1/audit/verify` | Verify |
| POST | `/api/v1/auth/login` | Login |
| POST | `/api/v1/auth/signup` | Signup |
| GET | `/api/v1/documents` | List Documents |
| POST | `/api/v1/documents` | Upload Document |
| GET | `/api/v1/health/live` | Health Live |
| GET | `/api/v1/health/ready` | Health Ready |
| POST | `/api/v1/query` | Query |
| GET | `/api/v1/usage/budget` | Get Budget |
| PUT | `/api/v1/usage/budget` | Put Budget |
| GET | `/api/v1/usage/summary` | Summary |
